title: Error shape (draft v0.1)
description: What a client may show or log about a failure. Status: DRAFT v0.1 — not frozen. `message` is plain-word, bounded and written for the learner; raw provider payloads, stack traces, secrets and learner content are rejected by the explicit false schemas below. `category` is the stable machine contract; `code` is a finer stable identifier. `retryable` is true only for transient conditions — client mistakes must never be offered as auto-retryable.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. provider.unavailable. Not shown to learners.

category.description: Stable category for client logic and support docs; frozen in Phase 03.

message.description: Plain-word, learner-facing message. Never a stack trace, raw provider dump, secret or learner content.

retryable.description: True only when retrying could genuinely succeed (transient network/provider/service states).
